author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be an elevation and the groundwork laid for "predictive" policing in the future. Algorithms will one day flag you before you do anything wrong and the world will edge closer to the dystopian movies of the early 2000s and the late 90s, unless you start changing things now. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: Be Careful What You Post Now...
